validity_window.basis: short delivery window for this mock commercial rehearsal on a changeable public commercial site

expiry_triggers: handoff occurs after the declared valid_through time
known site deploy or material content change
material rebuild or mutation of client-facing package
handoff_gate: Before Step21 actual distribution, confirm the validity window has not expired and no event-trigger has occurred; otherwise rerun affected current-site checks before handoff.
claim_boundary: Freshness is a time-bounded release condition, not a timeless truth about the site.
non_repeat_controls: FRESH AT QA TIME != FRESH AT DELIVERY TIME
